notes: Exposure: share of teams holding the player (mine: my teams in that window; field: every team in it). Drafted%: share of that window's pods that drafted him. lift10: top-10% lift against same-contest, same-price teams (money_report.md). verdict: the MONEY column of decision_register.csv as approved; current: this run's read (after the price-split check where it ran). mine: my teams where the decision applied, season to date (top-10% and top-1% rates over the field's). A player's lift10: his holders' top-10% rate over the window's (20+ holders). results: my teams last night (fees and winnings in dollars, finishes as top x%). card: my teams last night at each turn (faller, reach, trust; a reach's direction) and holding same-position teammates or opposing stars, with how many finished top 10%. card_decisions: per draft-card decision, last night and season to date, my teams doing it (share of my teams at that turn, or of all my teams) against the field's share, and vs_field_top1 / vs_field_top10: the top-1% and top-10% rate of the field's teams doing it over the whole field's rate in their contest (every team counts; no price matching, so a cheaper or pricier build's edge is in it). One night is noisy; the season line is the read.
